facts.fact: ITWeb reports the Information Regulator is taking a more proactive approach to enforcing POPIA, per Prof Sizwe Snail ka Mtuze.
ITWeb reports the Information Regulator recently imposed a R1 million administrative fine on First National Bank for contravening multiple POPIA provisions after a client data compromise.
ITWeb quotes Prof Mtuze saying POPIA came fully into effect five years ago and is beginning to deliver results.
The Information Regulator is reported enforcing POPIA, including by administrative fine.
The Information Regulator recently fined First National Bank R1 million under POPIA after a client data compromise, per ITWeb.
